title: nan
authors: Wang S.; Liang Y.; Liao S.; Xiao S.; Wang L.
key_contribution: Proposes LiVIC-EKF, a LiDAR-visual-inertial multi-sensor fusion framework for 6DoF pose estimation in underground GNSS-denied coal mines, validated on the KITTI dataset.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
